name: Historical monthly weather patterns
status: trained descriptive model derived from genuine cached NASA observations

scope.spatialInterpretation: Regional gridded MERRA-2/POWER meteorology, not a farm sensor or field-resolution observation.

features.label: Monthly precipitation total
features.aggregation: sum of daily mm/day values over the month

features.label: Fraction of days with precipitation below 1 mm
features.aggregation: count(daily precipitation < 1 mm) / complete days; descriptive threshold

aggregation.missingnessPolicy: Exclude incomplete/invalid months; no imputation or rainfall upscaling.
aggregation.observationStatus: monthly aggregation of genuine cached observations

split.policy: chronological; heldout months never fit scaling, centers, names or restart selection

fit.stoppingRule: unchanged training memberships or maximum iterations
fit.selectionCriterion: lowest training inertia; deterministic tie break

labelRules.interpretation: Relative descriptive names from learned centers, not crop thresholds or drought classes.

metricInterpretation: Quantization errors measure distance from learned historical centers in standardized feature space. They are not predictive accuracy, success probabilities or future-climate validation.

provenance.cachedHeaderScope: The cache retains the final yearly (2024) response header; the daily rows cover all seven verified years.

limitations: One regional point, seven years and only 60 training months; strong seasonality and correlated features limit independence.
Four clusters were chosen as a compact descriptive demonstration, not selected as a universal or optimal climate classification.
Tmin and Tmax are correlated and both enter the distance; rainfall totals and dry-day fraction can also be correlated.
Monthly rainfall totals depend partly on month length; dry-day fraction uses the stated 1 mm/day descriptive threshold.
No crop, soil, yield, irrigation, suitability, forecast or groundwater model is trained here; no agronomic validation is claimed.
A heldout nearest-center assignment describes a supplied historical month. It is not a forecast or calibrated probability.
